appearance_notes: Original 4K hero-color and 2K auxiliary maps; no photographic texels or baked highlights.
Blender and UE share the same detailed exported geometry; no Blender-only subdivision modifier.
Dynamic display uses bounded PN with <=0.12mm offset from the accepted physical boundary.
Static liver bed neighborhood is unchanged; other liver patches are bounded by 0.12mm.
Static FBX in explicit cm; importer must verify correspondence before acceptance.
Normal maps change shading normals only; dataset geometric normals remain explicit geometry normals.
Material revision 2: original multiscale serosal colour, tapered vascular branches, restrained wet roughness and fine normal detail; no photographic pixels, baked lighting or geometry changes.

Candidate static liver macroform: altered collider and display beyond the protected hepatic bed; gallbladder material mesh unchanged. Noninteractive ducts have continuous routes and buried terminal centers. Clinical anatomy review pending.
Final candidate: hilar orientation landmarks take a posterior/inferior course into the liver instead of arching through the working jaws; anatomy review remains pending.

orientation.x: lateral (simulation axis, not a patient DICOM axis)
orientation.y: fundus to neck; left tool enters from negative Y and right from positive Y in the engineering rig
orientation.scope: local gallbladder working field; not a complete abdomen

dynamic_display.binding: Recompute bounded PN on every accepted physical boundary state; exported GPU geometry uses exactly this surface.

phase6_interaction.scope: Engineering interaction rig, not clinical trocar placement guidance.
